frontier_selector.why: The presence of a hyperreflective area at external retinal layers and disruption of the ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor, and interdigitation zone, along with a mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE, specifically supports Phototoxic Maculopathy.

support_spans: Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
Mild eminence of retinal pigment epithelium at fovea
A 13-year-old female presented with vision loss and scotomas in the right eye
